title: Coincidence of Alice's and coarse conditioning when Bob's special bit is off
statement:
Let $\omega$ be a sample of the hard distribution, with special coordinate $T$, and let $X_{<T}$ denote Alice's input bits at the coordinates strictly before $T$ (padded with $\mathrm{false}$ elsewhere), $Y_{\ge T}$ Bob's input bits at the coordinates from $T$ onward (padded with $\mathrm{false}$ elsewhere), and $Y_{>T}$ Bob's input bits at the coordinates strictly after $T$ (padded with $\mathrm{false}$ elsewhere). If Bob's bit at the special coordinate is $\mathrm{false}$, then Alice's corrected special-coordinate conditioning variable and the coarse conditioning variable coincide:
\[
(T,\; X_{<T},\; Y_{\ge T}) \;=\; (T,\; X_{<T},\; Y_{>T}).
\]
hypotheses_covered: Bob's bit at the special coordinate T is false (specialY ω = false)
replaced: On the branch $Y_{T}=false$, Alice's corrected conditioning is exactly the coarse conditioning from $Z=(M,T,X_{<T},Y_{>T})$.
